purpose: Semantic forward tests for independent agent runs; use disposable fixtures, never live production.

scenarios.request: Deliver an approval API and browser form with PostgreSQL persistence. Only supervisors can approve; repeated requests must not duplicate audit events. The worker may fail after committing the transaction.
assertions: Acceptance includes denied users and duplicate requests
Plan establishes transactional audit and idempotency boundaries
Tasks map criteria to verifiable behavior
UI/UX/backend/data/operations applicability assessed
Release addresses migration compatibility and recovery

scenarios.request: Add a Salesforce approval flow with Apex integration and a Lightning action. One role can approve, another can view only, and certain fields must remain hidden. The downstream system can time out.
assertions: Actual edition/API and org evidence requested or marked unresolved
Record, object and field access distinguished
Flow/Apex execution and bulk behavior addressed
Metadata/data/environment settings separated
No invented test execution or fixed coverage requirement

scenarios.request: Add an incident escalation flow and catalog UI. The change includes a role, a system property and an integration credential reference. Development and QA have different endpoint settings.
assertions: Scope, ACL and cross-scope dependencies assessed
Package route verified for actual application
Environment properties/manual steps and secrets excluded from package assumptions
ATF and identity-specific behavior planned
Import success not treated as functional proof

scenarios.request: Extend an SAP order approval process and export audit events. Product edition and landscape are not yet supplied.
assertions: Material product/landscape uncertainty blocks implementation
No universal transport command or rollback promised
Native/developer/side-by-side options evaluated only after product discovery
Authorizations and segregation of duties identified
Business data and corrective transport/recovery addressed

scenarios.request: Change Maximo work-order validation, an automation script, a security group and a mobile application screen. The installed version is unknown.
assertions: Product/version and application type uncertainty explicit
Site/org access and script launch context assessed
Configuration and application-source migration routes distinguished
Excluded artifacts and manual steps identified
No universal Migration Manager coverage assumed

scenarios.request: Run the full factory in a host without separate agent invocations.
assertions: Reports missing delegation capability
Does not self-author all roles or claim independent reviews
Preserves already created evidence and reports next action
